description: This file defines a configuration class for integrating Clarifai as a chat completion provider compatible with OpenAI APIs. It extends a base OpenAI configuration class, provides methods to retrieve API parameters, transform requests and responses, and handle errors specific to Clarifai.

classes.name: ClarifaiConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Clarifai chat completions, extending OpenAIGPTConfig, providing API parameter handling, request/response transformation, and error management tailored for Clarifai.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI-compatible parameters supported by Clarifai models.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API key for Clarifai, either from a parameter or secrets manager.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_base(api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Provides the default API base URL for Clarifai if not specified.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_base_model(model: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Constructs a base URL for a model given a model string formatted as user_id.app_id.model_id.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Returns the API base URL and API key for the Clarifai provider.

methods.name: transform_request(self, model, messages, optional_params, litellm_params, headers)
methods.description: Transforms the request parameters for Clarifai models, extending the base transformation.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the Clarifai API response into a standard ModelResponse, handling JSON parsing and error checking.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an error class appropriate for Clarifai API errors, leveraging OpenAI error handling conventions.
